3. Does the overview account for publication bias, particularly with studies that remain
unpublished? If not, this should be acknowledged in the limitations section. Additionally, it would
be useful to discuss whether and how the inclusion of grey literature could alter your findings.

RESPONSE: Thank you. We have added the following limitation under the Discussion section
“We did not consider publication bias in the included reviews. It is uncertain whether
publication bias affected the results of the included reviews. To the extent it did, the results
may overestimate the effects of the interventions.”
ERIC and Education Research Complete include some grey literature. We did not otherwise
conduct any specific searches for grey literature. The detailed search strategies are in
Appendices A and B.
